name: Summer Playground Program (SPP)
description_short: An 8-week town-run summer day program at the Community Field playground, 9 am to 3:30 pm, for North Attleboro residents entering grades 1 through 6. A drop-in option lets families pick any 10 days, and a similar program (SPP2) serves residents entering grades 7 and 8.

warnings: This is a town Parks & Recreation overview page covering programs in every season (sports, zoo programs, swim lessons, adult classes), not a page for one camp. This listing covers only the Summer Playground Program.

No season year, dates or prices are given anywhere on the page. The descriptions look like they are reused every year (for example, robotics 'offered for the first time in the Summer and Fall of 2012').
SPP is limited to North Attleboro residents. Summer Sports Weeks and some other summer programs are open to all area residents.
Extended hours are not guaranteed: 'if there is enough interest in extended hours, we have run them in the past.'
The program site (Community Field playground) is not the same as the office address recorded here.
